_doc: verify: known faults (the lint backlog lives in tools/lint/allow.json) (stay red, are marked KNOWN) and deliberate exceptions (not reported). match: field → RegExp against the finding (check, rule, page, view, size, theme, sel, text). Every exception needs a reason; known faults name the stage in which they get fixed. Change entries only on request.

exceptions.reason: Timeline bars are dense data points on the time axis (12 px high). Large fallback on touch: tapping the row (name, ≥ 40 px high) opens the detail with the individual runs (onRow); a tap on the bar shows the data card, the second tap opens the detail (onItem).

Heatmap cells (10×12 px) are dense data points. Large fallback on touch: the row is a 40 px high hit area (selects the nearest cell, dragging scrubs, the second tap triggers onItem) and the row/entry opens the detail with the individual runs.
